summary: This directory centralizes the identification, discovery, and structural analysis of TypeScript projects within a workspace. It provides the necessary infrastructure to locate project configuration files and generate metadata, enabling consistent project-level access for tooling operations.
responsibilities: Discover TypeScript projects within a repository structure
Analyze project configuration files such as package.json and workspace definitions
Provide standardized metadata and context for identified projects
List and validate active TypeScript project configurations
relationships: The discovery process identifies valid TypeScript projects by inspecting workspace configuration files.
Project metadata is extracted during the discovery process to inform other components about available build targets.
The workspace context aggregates individual project details and version mappings to form a complete view of the environment.
designDecisions: Use of standardized interfaces for workspace and project definitions
Decoupling of project identification from project analysis
Support for multiple configuration file standards
